summaries.Romania: Romania faces administrative reform with voluntary commune mergers and parliamentary reduction proposals, while healthcare concerns mount over medication abuse and Pfizer's ongoing financial dispute impacts state operations.

items.title: 15 Organizations Call on Congress to Address Abuse of Drug Patent System
items.snippet:
Fifteen consumer advocacy groups urged Congress to reform drug patent laws, arguing pharmaceutical companies exploit them to delay competition and raise prices.
The post 15 Organizations Call on Congress to Address Abuse of Drug Patent System appeared first on MedCity News.
items.line: Drug patent reform advocacy targets pharmaceutical pricing power through legislative restrictions.

items.title: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over worries about Huang’s ties with China
